sources.policy: 32 unique ordinary shadow-casting CPU meshes; canonical semantic ordering

inputs.scope: Test-only semantic CPU mesh, source selection, fixed clock, draw-list and Nani cull inputs. Does not claim complete GPU scene equivalence.

cpu.scope: 1-second process snapshots; 100% is one CPU core; sampled subrange excludes startup/warmup, not exact full-frame CPU attribution.

thread_cpu.scope: Actual user+kernel CPU time; GPU execution and sleeping waits excluded. Means over observed frame range, not per-frame p95 or a parallel critical-path measurement. Exited/new threads excluded from the persistent-thread sum.

measurement.scope: Real desktop loop and native WSI; render-feedback intervals measure throughput, not GPU completion or photon latency. Stage wall times overlap CPU/GPU work and must not be summed. Missing timing rows/counters mean instrumentation was disabled.
